what_happened: Task 786's premise -- four wired evidence probes with independent source-level compile failures needing per-probe repair/restatement/retirement -- is falsified by re-measurement. All four compile today unchanged since 2026-10-03, and 'bash scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh' prints 'PASS all 33 wired probe(s) compile'. The archived phase-4 gate log from the originating run shows all four errors were 'object file ... does not exist' missing-.olean I/O errors on four distinct FormalSystem import-closure tail modules (Metalogic, MainResults, Examples.Walkthrough, Examples), on four CONSECUTIVE WIRED entries (9-12 of 33), with those oleans' mtimes falling inside the gate's own run window. Root cause is a .lake read/write race: check-evidence-probes.sh calls bare 'lake env lean' 33 times without taking the shared .lake/build-guard.lock that check-module-invariants.sh and lake-build-guard.sh both take.

The originating run's full gate output, including the per-probe error text the task description lacked, survived in the prior session's scratchpad (p4-gate.log) and subagent transcript. Reading those turned an open four-way diagnosis into a single-cause determination in minutes and avoided four speculative probe rewrites.
